head: 74df8cfd74fa7eef58c938e57adb2b6c3d947b9c
headline: Checkout now retries the card payment up to three times when the payment company is slow or briefly down. It is safe to ship.
what_changed: When the card payment company times out, has a network hiccup or reports a temporary error on its side, checkout now tries again automatically instead of failing at once.
It tries at most 3 times, with short pauses (under one second) between tries.
Clear refusals, such as a declined or invalid card, are not retried. The customer sees the failure straight away, as before.
Every retry carries the same order reference. This is the payment company's protection against doing the same thing twice, so a retry cannot double-charge the customer.
The change is committed on its own branch, not the main version. A file that records exact add-on code versions was also created on the computer but is not part of the commit.

risks.title: Customers may wait up to about 25 seconds
risks.explanation: Each payment attempt can wait up to 8 seconds before giving up. With 3 attempts and the pauses between them, a customer could wait about 25 seconds before seeing an error when the payment company is fully down. Some customers may refresh or leave in that time. It only happens during a payment-company outage, and fixing it would only mean shortening the wait.

questions_for_developer: If the first payment attempt times out but the payment company is still working on it, what does the company answer when we retry with the same order reference? Could the order be marked 'failed' even though the card was actually charged? This could already happen before the change, but it would be good to know.
When the payment company says 'too many requests, slow down', should checkout wait and try again? Right now it doesn't.
Is there a screen or spinner that keeps the customer informed if payment takes 20 seconds or more?
good_news: Double charges are prevented: every retry reuses the same order reference, and the existing code really does send it to the payment company.
Only temporary problems are retried. Declined cards and other clear refusals still fail immediately.
The change is small, contained to the checkout payment step, and passes the automatic code check.
